title: ATLAS model card — procurement-ready conformance profile
description: What a buyer needs to evaluate fit: identity and provenance, imaging modality, intended use/users and cautioned out-of-scope use, input/output/architecture/limitations/availability/instructions, a declared clinical risk level, at least one performance record, and at least one regulatory-authorization record (an explicit "Not submitted" is an acceptable, expected answer for a research model).
$comment: Conformance profile per atlas-chai-crosswalk.md Priority 4 / atlas-conformance-profiles.md. This is an overlay: it adds only `required`/cardinality narrowing over schema-2026-12/model.json via allOf, per the note's "required does not cascade" and "required is satisfied by an empty string" traps (each nested `required` is restated at every level down to the leaf, and array/string leaves that lack a base minItems/minLength get one added here). It defines no new properties, so it is unaffected by the base schema's additionalProperties:false. Clinical risk level was DEFERRED at this profile's creation and has since been added to the base schema (ROADMAP:04127); promoted to required below. Still DEFERRED pending fields that do not yet exist in the base schema (per the note's "profiles cannot ship first"): targeted patient population; performance-record Test type (internal/external) and test dataset linkage beyond the existing free-text Evaluation dataset; a Datasets field or explicit inline data-provenance statement. These will be added to this profile once the corresponding base-schema fields exist.
